name: Chinese SimpleQA
intro: Chinese SimpleQA是首个全面的中文基准，旨在评估大型语言模型回答简短问题的能力。该基准涵盖6个主要主题和99个子主题，并通过严格的质量控制流程确保问题和答案的高质量。其特点包括中文、多样性、高质量、静态和易于评估，可用于指导开发者理解模型在中文事实性方面的表现。
org: LivingFutureLab, Tsinghua University, Beijing Institute of Technology, Shanghai Jiao Tong University
eval_feature_en: Dynamic Update, Contamination-free, Adversarial, Chain-of-Thought, Zero-shot
intro_en: Chinese SimpleQA is the first comprehensive Chinese benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to answer short questions. It covers 6 main topics and 99 subtopics, with strict quality control ensuring high-quality questions and answers. Features include Chinese language, diversity, high quality, static nature, and ease of evaluation, making it useful for developers to understand model performance on Chinese factuality.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2411.07140. The paper states that Chinese SimpleQA construction combines automated construction with human verification. The automated phase extracts and filters knowledge-rich content from sources such as Wikipedia using a quality assessment model, prompts an LLM to generate short question-answer pairs, checks predefined criteria including objective and unique answers, static answers, challenge level, and answerability by December 31, 2023, then uses RAG verification with LlamaIndex over Google and Bing search results. The difficulty filter removes questions answered correctly by all four powerful baseline models. Human quality control has two annotators independently check compliance and answer using authoritative sources with at least two supporting URLs; a third annotator resolves inconsistent answers. The final retention compares human annotations with LLM-generated answers and keeps only fully consistent pairs, reducing 10,000 initial pairs through difficulty, rule/RAG validation, and manual review to about 3,000 samples across six primary topics.
